steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Drain and rinse the cooked chickpeas, then mash them in a large bowl until mostly smooth.
Add the mashed banana and unsweetened applesauce to the bowl and stir to combine.
Mix in the vanilla extract and cinnamon until evenly distributed.
Add the oat flour and baking powder, then stir until a soft dough forms.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the baking sheet, pressing each into a flat round.
Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until the cookies are set and lightly golden on the bottom.
Cool completely on the sheet before serving. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
